VindaAvanti.name: Vinda
VindaAvanti.note: King of Avanti, son of Rajadhidevi; with his brother Anuvinda he fought for the Kauravas (a namesake of one of the hundred Kauravas).

AnuvindaAvanti.name: Anuvinda
AnuvindaAvanti.note: King of Avanti, son of Rajadhidevi and brother of Vinda; a Kaurava ally.

Jayasena_2.name: Jayasena
Jayasena_2.note: King of Avanti, husband of Rajadhidevi and father of Vinda and Anuvinda. SB 9.24.42
